errors.fix: Run the command from inside a git repository, or run 'git init' to create one

errors.fix: Run 'git pull --rebase' to incorporate the remote changes, then push again
Resolve the conflicting files, then 'git add' them and continue the merge/rebase

errors.message: Git refuses to operate on a repo owned by another user
errors.fix: Run 'git config --global --add safe.directory <path>' for the repo path

errors.message: Git could not reach the remote host
errors.fix: Check your network connection and that the remote URL is correct

errors.message: Tried to add a remote named 'origin' that already exists
errors.fix: Use 'git remote set-url origin <url>' to change it, or 'git remote remove origin' first

errors.message: Tried to merge two branches with no common commit history
errors.fix: Add '--allow-unrelated-histories' to the merge/pull command if this is intentional

errors.fix: Check your SSH key is added to the agent and registered with the remote host

errors.message: The remote repository doesn't exist or you don't have access to it
